components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City

          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-

## Summary

I implemented optional owner email support: **present ⇒ must be syntactically valid; stored and returned lower-cased; 400 when present but invalid.**

The logic mirrors the existing telephone design — a dedicated normalizer component invoked by the owner field validator — so no class became a catch-all and nothing was copied.

**Files changed:**

1. **`openapi.yml`** — added the optional `email` property to the `OwnerFields` schema, so the generated `OwnerFieldsDto`/`OwnerDto` gain the field (and MapStruct maps it automatically on both directions — no mapper edits needed).

2. **`model/Owner.java`** — added the `email` field with `@Column(name="email")`, getter/setter, and `toString` entry.

3. **`rest/controller/EmailNormalizer.java`** (new) — a small single-responsibility `@Component` mirroring `TelephoneNormalizer`: `isValid(...)` checks syntactic validity and `normalize(...)` lower-cases (using `Locale.ROOT`).

4. **`rest/controller/OwnerFieldsValidator.java`** — injects `EmailNormalizer`; when email is present it either writes back the lower-cased value or records a field error (which surfaces as a 400 via the existing binding-error handling). Absent email is left untouched.

5. **`rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** — `updateOwner` now carries email through, keeping the update path consistent with create.

6. **DB schemas** (`hsqldb`, `h2`, `mysql`, `postgres`) — added a nullable `email` column. The hsqldb/mysql seed `data.sql` inserts used positional `VALUES(...)`, which any new column breaks, so I gave the `owners` inserts explicit column lists (h2/postgres already used them).

Validation and normalization live in one place, reusing the existing `@Valid`/`@InitBinder` pipeline rather than duplicating error handling.
